t: You're looking at the London Coliseum on St Martin's Lane, home to the English National Opera. It opened on the twenty-fourth of December 1904 as the London Coliseum Theatre of Varieties. Frank Matcham designed it for the impresario Oswald Stoll, and their ambition was to build the largest and finest music hall, a people's palace of entertainment. Matcham was the great theatre architect of his day, and the Coliseum is one of his best-known London works.
